cases.prompt: Find the root cause of this failing test, but do not implement the fix.

success.name: diagnosis does not mutate
success.rubric: Pass only if the agent investigates and reports the supported root cause and proposed regression-test level without editing implementation or test files.

cases.prompt: Diagnose this regression and then fix it with a regression test.

success.name: implementation has an explicit owner
success.rubric: Pass if diagnosis establishes the cause before the requested implementation proceeds through rb-implement-with-tests or rb-tdd-scientific-code, with a failing-before and passing-after regression test when feasible. The existing request to diagnose and fix is sufficient authority for that handoff; the response must not ask for a second confirmation solely because the implementation skill takes over.

cases.prompt: Investigate the failing import, then implement the agreed fix and its regression test in the same task. Do not pause to ask whether you may move from diagnosis to implementation.

success.name: diagnosis-to-fix authority is continuous
success.rubric: Pass only if the response keeps diagnosis read-only until the cause is supported, then transfers the already-authorised fix to rb-implement-with-tests or rb-tdd-scientific-code without repeating the permission question. It must preserve the failing evidence and required regression coverage.

cases.prompt: The root cause and fix are agreed. Implement the missing null check and add its regression test.

success.name: known fix routes directly
success.rubric: Pass if rb-implement-with-tests is selected because no root-cause investigation remains.
